q: 蓝驰从第一次接触到打款，关键节点有哪些？
reply: From first contact to money in, the timeline:

Aug 19: first meeting. Sep 3: talked terms. Sep 10: signed TS at 7500万. Sep 24: they re-cut to 7200万, you accepted. Oct 4: they split into two tranches. Oct 14: first 300万 hit. Oct 26: second 300万 hit.
Key moments: the Sep 21 user growth model video call and the Sep 24 renegotiation. Total about two and a half months from first meeting to full funding.
